name: Tippu Tip across Africa
traveler: Hamed bin Muhammed el-Murjebi, called Tippu Tip
summary: A Zanzibari trader in ivory and slaves builds a state on the upper Congo. He escorts Stanley down the Lualaba in 1876, and in 1887 goes to the Congo the other way, round the Cape and up the river, as the Free State's governor at Stanley Falls. His caravans make him one of very few people of his time to cross Africa in both directions.
